text:
**Best complete kit: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with two 200 W panels.** It’s a close match to your target at **2,042 Wh**, supplies **2,200 W** of AC output, and includes **400 W of solar panels**—a stronger ready-to-use panel bundle than a kit with just one 200 W panel. [Generator & Backup’s comparison](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup) names it the most complete solar backup kit.

If you’d rather prioritize battery capacity and inverter power, consider the **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2**: **2,073.6 Wh**, **2,600 W** output, and up to **1,000 W** solar input. Its one-panel 200 W kit is listed at **$1,199**, but the source estimates that panel could take **2–3 sunny days** to refill the battery; the two-panel 400 W version is listed at **$1,499**. [Kit details and prices](https://dealectric.com/best-2000wh-solar-generator-kit-with-panels).

**Bottom line:** I’d choose the Jackery for a well-balanced kit that comes with a useful amount of panel capacity. If choosing BLUETTI, I’d lean toward its two-panel bundle rather than the single-panel kit.

products: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
judge.why: The answer's top pick is the Jackery Explorer 2000 v2, which isn't in our catalog and is sourced from Generator & Backup; the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 kit from dealectric.com is only the alternative.
